item.title: Mitsubishi revives Pajero flagship
item.description: Mitsubishi Motors has brought back one of its best-known nameplates with the unveiling of the all-new Pajero, a fully redesigned cross-country SUV that will serve as the brand’s new-generation flagship.

item.title: Toyota sets TGR Esports National Finals
item.description: Twenty sim racers will compete for national honors when Toyota Motor Philippines (TMP) stages the 2026 TOYOTA GAZOO Racing Philippines Esports GT Championship National Finals on 27 September at the SMX Convention Center in Pasay City.

item.title: Silver streak in Baku: Russell leads Mercedes 1-2 during Azerbaijan GP practice
item.description: Baku, Azerbaijan (AFP) — George Russell topped the times ahead of teammate and world championship leader Kimi Antonelli as Mercedes dominated Friday’s second practice for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
